title: Define Papyrus shared chat trust boundary contract
description: Add a code-local reusable admission contract for site-hosted shared chat. Inject a verified Papyrus principal and membership resolver; derive Account/site/editor on the server; enforce private per-editor transcript ownership and operation-scoped idempotency with payload-reuse rejection. Cover rejection and replay behavior in tests and Gherkin. Document that JWT audience, client_id and token_use are distinct and that the production token type and verifier configuration must be verified before wiring. No exposed endpoint, live AppSync changes, live IAM/OIDC, or deployment.
